summary.live_verification: spectral screenshots: (1) encounter with Bless badge (8r + concentration marker), Guidance with USE action, Break Concentration control on the source combatant; (2) character sheet 'At roll time' section — +1d4 attack/save (Bless), Disadvantage attack + Advantage incoming (Restrained), and DEX-save Cancelled (Restrained disadvantage + Haste advantage netted) — confirms the netting + colour coding; (3) compendium Invocations tab, 32 SRD rows, collapsible bodies. Live rollModifiers/rollAdvantages JSON from the PUT matched the rendered output.

edge_cases: Consumed-on-use badges show both a 'use' button and the ✕ — both call DELETE. Intentional: 'use' = spent (semantic), ✕ = remove-by-mistake. Minor redundancy, accepted.
Concentration source is set only at apply time via the palette dropdown; changing it later means re-applying (backend upserts). Acceptable for v1.

adversarial_notes: No-double-counting invariant honoured: flat riders are NOT rendered as separate instructions — only RollModifierKind.Dice and the rollAdvantages list surface; flat folds stay inside the derived save/skill/attack numbers. Verified live (the displayed riders match the backend's rollModifiers/rollAdvantages, which exclude flat).
All new response fields are optional (consumedOnUse?, remainingRounds?, rollModifiers?, rollAdvantages?, etc.) — the client degrades cleanly if the backend omits them (e.g. an older deploy).
handleAddStatusEffect signature changed to take the StatusEffectResponse (to read defaultDurationRounds); the only caller (the palette chip) was updated to pass the object. No other callers (grep).

breakConcentration control gated on isConcentrationSource (any badge in the encounter sourced by this combatant) — verified it appears on the source and the action drops the effect via the new endpoint.

Compendium: the three catalogs share { id, name, description }; SimpleEntry reuses the existing EntryShell/Header/Desc primitives; groupRows fallthrough renders them as one flat sorted group. No new list/sort/filter logic.
PlayerEncounterView shares the badge classes but not the new DM-only controls (palette/break-concentration are inside isDm blocks) — players see badges, not the controls. No leak.

accept: Reused EntryShell for the compendium catalogs instead of a new component — minimal surface.
Module-level summarizeRiders / ROLL_TARGET_LABEL keep the tooltip/label logic pure and testable.

Rendering the character-level aggregated rollModifiers/rollAdvantages (deduped, netted server-side) rather than re-deriving from per-effect riders client-side — defers to the backend's authoritative computation.

deferred: Pipeline health/drift-sentinel fails: documented repo-reality (baseline anti-patterns; oby npm-spawn os error 193). Authoritative build+lint ran green at HEAD.
new_pitfalls: Catalog ids look like 5a7e00XX-0000-...-0000000000XX — when debugging, never use a slice(0,8) display id as a real GUID in an API call (STJ rejects it as a request-deserialization failure, not an obvious 'bad id' error).
